source_quotes.n_subjects: Imaging was performed on two unheated swine for two minutes using the fSPGR sequence followed by MRTI computation of temperature changes maps three techniques: referenceless PRFS, corrected PRFS, and conventional PRFS.

flags.reason: No sonication parameters (frequency, pressure, intensity, timing) are given anywhere in the paper: the liFUS prototype was not energized in any experiment reported (MRTI feasibility and MR-compatibility testing only, in unheated swine and unheated phantoms). This placeholder exposure records the intended DRG target and device only.

readout_other: MR thermometry imaging (referenceless PRFS, corrected PRFS, conventional PRFS) via fSPGR sequence; B0 field-inhomogeneity and B1 RF transmit field mapping
direction_notes: This is a device/MR-thermometry feasibility study; no ultrasound stimulation was delivered to the swine or phantoms (the liFUS prototype was not energized during any imaging described), so no neuromodulatory effect was assessed.
safety_notes: The liFUS device prototype was not energized during the swine or phantom imaging reported here; the study characterizes MR thermometry accuracy and MR-compatibility of the prototype materials in preparation for future energized studies.

exposures.label: Intended liFUS treatment target (device not energized in this study)

timing.protocol_description: No active ultrasound stimulation was delivered in this study. The liFUS prototype (housing plus internal coax and silver wiring) was placed on swine and on a phantom purely to assess MR thermometry accuracy and MR-compatibility; the device 'was not energized during the acquisition' of any of the imaging datasets described.
